notes.title: A New Title From The Creator of Bouncing DVD : The Game
notes.content:
Hey there fellow bouncers!

Following the exciting news of leaderboard resets, i'm proud to announce a new title! out now!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1556680/OVERSTARS/]OVERSTARS[/url] is my new game, out literally right now! It's as cheap as some chips and it's as hard as uh... a thing that's hard, I guess?

It's equally simple to Bouncing DVD : The Game with WASD controls but incredibly difficult. Give it a go, you might like it! Or don't. I ain't your boss.

As always, stay safe and keeeeep bouncing.
(P.S, this will be the last announcement for a while. 2 announcements in 2 days is a bit spammy, sorry!)

notes.title: Introducing... Leaderboard Resets.
notes.content:
I've been missing a bit of friendly competition inside the Bouncing DVD : The Game community. The leaderboards have long become somewhat stuck in there ways... so that's why, starting literally RIGHT NOW, i'm gonna reset the leaderboards every week! 

There's no grand prize for being Number 1 in the world... other than being Number 1 In The World, of course!

So good luck Bouncers!

notes.title: Bouncing Back!
notes.content:
[b] Hello, is this thing on? Testing, 1 2 ... [/b]

Hey there! How's it going? It's been a hot minute since I last talked to you guys!

First things first, I, the original developer, am back. I won't bore you with details but trust me, you'll like this...

- The update that was requested last year is finally coming, it's ready! just going through a few tweaks and it'll  be ready for you guys to ... bounce back into ;)

- Social media! Back from the dead, my socials rise... here's some links:

Twitter! For my hottest takes, game dev stories and midnight rambles, it's gotta be [url=https://twitter.com/RoomsForRockets]@RoomsForRockets[/url]

Patreon! If you're feeling generous and want to support me and my games, head over to [url=https://www.patreon.com/RoomsForRockets]The RoomsForRockets Patreon[/url]


Anyway, i'll see you on flipflop.

Alex

notes.title: Bounce Onto Steam!
notes.content: We're out, guys! The game is out, woo! We've decided to delay the game's DLC for a small period of time, enjoy the game!

notes.title: Bounce Into Action!
notes.content:
[b]Welcome one and all to the Bouncing DVD : The Game Steam Page![/b]

I'm a one man[i] team [/i]who loves making games!
This game is a fun, timewasting free to play game.

The original game will always be free to play, there might be DLC coming in the future that will cost a small amount, 5 bucks or less, that won't be pay to win. I believe in fair gameplay. The scores on the paid DLC will not appear on the free to play leaderboard,  so it's completely fair!

Follow us (me) on twitter : ([url=https://twitter.com/RoomsForRockets]@RoomsForRockets[/url])
to keep up with the gamedev life! ːsteamhappyː
